function: Over-the-air aggregation of local federated-learning model updates in distributed mMIMO: non-coherent preamble-codeword aggregation with device power control and AP-side averaging (pp. 3-5).
system: Distributed mMIMO: 4 APs x 50 antennas vs one 200-antenna AP, K=10-250 devices (device antennas not stated), 1000 m square, 2 GHz, 20 MHz; no RIS (p. 6).
method: Linear support vector classifier trained with federated averaging: local SGD, quantized updates, non-coherent random-access over-the-air aggregation adapted from reference [13]; no neural network (pp. 4-5, 8).
data_channel: Custom simulation: uncorrelated Rician fading (5 dB), log-distance path loss (exponent 3), called a '3GPP channel model' citing TR 25.996; MNIST for the learning task (pp. 3-4, 6, 8-9).
test_conditions: No train/test condition split: each setting simulated alone, sweeping K 10-250, APs 2-16, side 400-2000 m, SNR 0-16 dB; SVC run at K=190, 4 APs, 1000 m (pp. 6-8).
baselines: Centralized mMIMO (one 200-antenna AP) running the scheme of Choi [13] under the same power limit and channel; results of [13] with Rayleigh fading, no power limit (p. 6).
metrics: Aggregation MSE; average, variance, maximum and minimum device transmit power (Table III); SVC accuracy per epoch on MNIST (pp. 6-8).
q1_support: p. 3: "we use a realistic 3GPP channel model with Rician fading [27]" ([27] is 3GPP TR 25.996, p. 9; the model itself is defined in Eqs. 1-4, pp. 3-4, and Table II, p. 6).
q2_support: p. 8: "The experiment assumes K = 190 devices" is one fixed setting; the other results sweep K, APs, area and SNR (Table II, p. 6) with no model trained in one condition and tested in another. Missing: any test in unseen conditions.
q3_support: p. 6: "which is the method in [13] but with the same constraints and channel model"; the only comparator is the scheme of [13]. Missing: a non-learned baseline (p. 3: "instead of benchmarking against algorithms designed for different contexts").
q4_support: p. 2: "increased infrastructure and coordination costs" is qualitative. Missing: any order of complexity, operations, parameters or runtime of the aggregation scheme.
q5_support: p. 8: "applied to the MNIST dataset" is a public dataset of the learning task alone; the channel is simulated (p. 3). Missing: any code or data link.
notes: Included as area 7: over-the-air FL aggregation. The no_learning check passes under the FL over-the-air rule, the learned element being a linear SVC on MNIST (p. 8). The AP arrays have 50 to 200 antennas (p. 6), so the system check passes. For the reviewer, q1: the paper says it uses a '3GPP channel model with Rician fading [27]' (p. 3), and [27] is TR 25.996, which is not on the q1 list; but the channel it defines (Eqs. 1-4, Table II) is spatially uncorrelated Rician fading with log-distance path loss, a custom simulator. Marked met under the 'another standardized model' rule; set 0 if judged a custom simulator. For q3: the baselines are only the scheme of [13] (as published and re-run centrally); the paper states it does not benchmark against other algorithms; no non-learned comparator such as ideal averaging or digital aggregation, so 0. The text extraction omits the bodies of Tables I-III; they were read from the page images (pp. 3, 6, 7).
